title: "Publish approved combined CVD metrics"

date-modified: 2026-08-28
---

## Run

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/monthly/bnr_step6_publish.do" 2024 4
```

Use `replace` only for deliberate republication of the same approved release.

## What Step 6 verifies and creates

Step 6 verifies `approval.yml`, the seven-file `public_manifest.csv`, and each
payload checksum. It writes the authoritative public package to:

`$BNR_PUBLIC/metrics/cvd/`

It mirrors only the stable current CSV, release ZIP and catalogue record to:

`$BNR_REPO/site/downloads/files/metrics/cvd/`

Private controls are not copied. Then run:

```powershell
python site/scripts/build_download_catalogue.py
```

An unchanged catalogue is normal when Step 6 has replaced the contents of an
existing release ZIP without changing the release identifier or its catalogue
record. Inspect the output package and download links before the normal commit,
render and deployment process.
